page.overview:
Who is Gabora?

The hulking Gabora, who is referred to as a "Deku Stick" by his business partner, seems to be the one who does all the forging while his superior relaxes and drinks a warm beverage. Despite his massive size, he does not seem to mind being ordered around constantly.

Gabora's name could possibly be a reference to Kaepora Gaebora.
